title: Juicy Pillowy Mediterranean Fish Paella
description: A flavorful and aromatic Mediterranean dish featuring fish, saffron, and floral notes, made with ayurvedic-tamasic friendly ingredients and a brine-dry method for tender fish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the fish fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, saffron threads, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the fish fillets to the bowl and coat them evenly with the marinade.
Let the fish marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato to the pan and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the marinated fish to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
